artworks.title: Chapel of the Cross (Cappella della Croce) [plate L]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene inside a chapel or church. The image depicts an interior view featuring an altar with a large framed artwork above it. This artwork portrays a figure in a robe with raised hands, set against a backdrop of nature, including rocky outcrops and trees. The drawing is intricately detailed, highlighting architectural elements such as columns and arches within the interior space. Various figures are present, primarily focused on observing or interacting with the scene in a devout or contemplative manner. The composition uses a strong contrast between light and shadow, creating a dramatic and solemn atmosphere typical of religious art.

artworks.title: Church of the Stigmata (Chiesa delle Stimmate) [plate M]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: This drawing portrays a religious sanctuary scene with an altar. The interior space showcases an ornate altar featuring a centrally displayed crucifix. Surrounding the crucifix are two angelic figures and religious iconography. Below them, figures are shown engaged in reverent or prayerful gestures. The setting includes architectural features like a high vaulted ceiling with decorative details, wooden choir stalls with figures in robes, a tiled floor, and a central open area where additional figures are depicted in various worshipful postures. The composition is balanced and symmetrical, with the crucifix as the central focal point. The detailed lines and rendering convey emotion and religious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Chapel of Saint Sebastian (Cappella di San Sebastiano) [plate N]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures and architectural elements. The drawing features an interior set within a religious or ceremonial space. In the center is a framed image of a male figure on a pedestal with his arms spread. The space is ornate, with arches and a niche above the framed image. Two figures in cloaks are kneeling on one knee in the foreground facing the icon. Another figure is entering the room from a door on the left side. The room has intricate stonework and archways, with light coming through a small window. Various letters and labels are included in the drawing.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Saint Francis (Tentazione di San Francesco) [plate O]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Raffaello Schiaminossi (etcher), Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration from a slightly elevated angle showing a dramatic cliff face. The scene focuses on vertical elements, with a figure standing on a high ledge near the top, accompanied by a tree. The cliff is craggy and textured with vertical striations, suggesting depth and height. The illustration is detailed with cross-hatching for shadows and depth, in a monochromatic palette of gray shades. Shrubs are at the bottom, and lush trees are at the top of the cliff. The overall impression is of a dramatic and mysterious landscape emphasizing verticality and texture.

artworks.title: Apparition of the Virgin in the Beech Tree (Faggio dell'apparizione della Vergine) [plate P]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Raffaello Schiaminossi (etcher), Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large tree with figures seated on its branches and an entrance at its base. This monochrome ink drawing depicts a massive tree with detailed bark and an entrance hollowed out at its base. Various figures can be seen, including a group standing at the base of the tree. The foliage is lush and meticulously illustrated, enhancing the ancient and mythical atmosphere of the artwork.

artworks.title: Chapel of the Spring in the Beech Tree (Cappella del faggio dell'acqua) [plate Q]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing with a monumental architectural structure resembling a large archway or gate. The scene includes abundant foliage of large trees framing the structure. A solitary figure is sitting beneath a tree in the distance. There are four figures standing in front of the archway, dressed in historical attire. The horizon is visible beyond the archway, marked by rolling hills. The overall color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey, typical of an engraving. The drawing uses fine hatching and cross-hatching to depict texture and shading in the brickwork, clothing, and foliage.

artworks.title: The Site of the Bed and Oratory of Saint Francis (Luogo del 'letto' e dell'oratorio di San Francesco) [plate R]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image shows a cavern with rock formations surrounding an opening or alcove. The rocks display detailed texture with dense linework. Two figures in robes are walking along a path next to a structured wall with a window. The scene is dominated by twisting branches and leaves of trees, with a monochromatic color palette of gray and brown.

artworks.title: Chapel of the Blessed John of La Verna (Cappella del beato Giovanni della Verna) [plate S]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image features a path leading to a small building among tall trees. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage and trees. The building sits centrally, surrounded by trees. The illustration uses traditional engraving techniques with cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from dark to light greys. Two human figures are present, one standing and one kneeling. In the distance is a house resembling a chapel or temple with a brick-like texture. The scene exudes tranquility and detail in depicting a woodland setting.

artworks.title: Monastic Cell of the Blessed John of La Verna (Cella del beato Giovanni della Verna) [plate T]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a rocky terrain with a small brick structure featuring an open doorway in the center. A figure stands to the left of the structure. Trees obscure the horizon, providing depth to the scene. The detailed rendering uses fine lines to depict textures and contrasts of light and shadow, with a monochromatic color palette of black and white.

artworks.title: The Rock of Brother Wolf (Sasso di fra' Lupo) [plate V]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Raffaello Schiaminossi (etcher), Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image shows a cliffside view with trees lining the horizon, creating a canopy. The trees emerge from the cliff edge, with detailed brushwork showing texture and shadow. Figures near the cliff edge are engaged in various activities. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing contrast between light and dark.

artworks.title: Beech Tree with the Bell (Faggio della campana) [plate X]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Raffaello Schiaminossi (etcher), Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image features an outdoor scene with a large tree in the center, spreading branches across the frame. The horizon is obscured by the dense foliage and tree trunk, with no distinct line visible. The brushstrokes are delicate and consistent, with fine lines and detailed textures of the tree bark and leaves. The color palette is grayscale, emphasizing the linework and shading. Three figures are near us, one pointing with a stick to the other two figures dressed in long cloaks. The foreground rock surface is shaded to suggest depth. A small building with a simple roof is seen among the trees in the back, partially hidden by foliage. The tree's trunk and hanging bell are prominent. Trees in the background create depth with shadows suggesting light play among the branches.

artworks.title: Stigmata of Saint Francis (Stimmate di San Francesco) [plate Y]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Raffaello Schiaminossi (etcher), Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure on a cliffs edge. The figure has wings and is radiating light, interacting with another figure by the cliff. The cliff has dense foliage at the top and small huts. The sky is lightly hatched, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Study for "Shoeing Calvary Horses at the Front" [verso]
artworks.artist: John Singer Sargent
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The image shows abstract pencil lines and shapes on a blank background. Most of the drawing is on the right side of the paper. The lines suggest a person bending over. The sketch is minimalistic with sparse lines, giving an abstract quality to the representation. The figure resembles a human form with lack of detail and simplicity of lines emphasizing the abstract nature of the artwork.

artworks.title: Antique Boar Hunt
artworks.artist: Gerhard Janssen
artworks.medium: etching and open-bite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: A frontal view of an action-packed hunting scene. The landscape includes two figures on horseback chasing a large boar with hunting dogs and an archer on foot. Trees in the background and foreground add detail to the scenery. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray, black, and white, creating contrast and drama.

artworks.title: Nymphs in a Landscape
artworks.artist: Gerhard Janssen
artworks.medium: etching and open-bite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a low horizon, dense trees, rising land formations, a figure tending to sheep in the distance, and intricate engraving details capturing textures. The dominant color palette is monochrome with a range of gray tones creating contrast between light and shadow. Figures are seated and standing with sheep and trees surrounding them, while the background is filled with intricate vegetation.

artworks.title: Riverbank at Night
artworks.artist: Charles Émile Jacque
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from a side perspective in a dark, wooded area. The background is filled with trees, creating an enclosed atmosphere. In the center, a figure is illuminated by a bright light source, possibly a lantern. The environment is shadowy, with cross-hatching adding texture and depth, especially in the foliage and ground. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray. There is a reflective water surface in the foreground, echoing the intricate lines of the composition.

artworks.title: Arabe assis (Seated Arab)
artworks.artist: Mariano Fortuny Marsal
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on japan paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with their knees drawn up to their chest. They are facing right, with their arms on their knees and hands clasped. The person's face is partially obscured by shadows and their head is leaning forward, partially covered by a hood or shawl. Their clothing covers most of their body, including a hood over their head. They appear to be sitting on the ground or a fabric/mat. The background has a textured wall, casting shadows.

artworks.title: The Pig Butcher
artworks.artist: Charles Émile Jacque
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on chinese paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring a figure interacting with a hanging carcass. The drawing depicts a dimly lit room where a solitary figure, holding a knife, is turned towards a suspended animal carcass. The detailed rendering suggests a rustic setting with simple furnishings, as there are a few wooden chairs placed within the scene, and shadows cast against a textured wall. The use of stark contrast and detailed lines adds depth to the scene, enhancing its atmospheric mood.

artworks.title: L'Amateur de jardin (The Gardening Enthusiast)
artworks.artist: Mariano Fortuny Marsal
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image is of a garden scene with an ornate birdbath surrounded by lush foliage. The drawing includes intricate details of leaves and flowers, with a textured background suggesting a natural setting. The elements are arranged to guide the eye across the composition, creating a sense of peacefulness. The lines are finely etched, reflecting a delicate technique capturing the beauty of a garden.

artworks.title: Sibyl Seen from the Back, Looking Downward to the Left
artworks.artist: Lambert Suavius
artworks.dimensions:
image: 17.5 × 8.3 cm (6 7/8 × 3 1/4 in.)
sheet: 17.7 × 8.4 cm (6 15/16 × 3 5/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of David A. Krol in Memory of his Brother Anthony J. Krol, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a person from the back, standing with their head turned slightly to the right. The individual has an updo hairstyle with soft curls and twists. They are wearing a long, flowing garment with gathers and pleats around the waist and shoulders, and their left hand is visible holding part of the garment over the right shoulder. One foot is slightly forward. The background has a textured, radiating halo effect surrounding the person in a black and white engraving style.

artworks.title: Oedipus (Oedipe)
artworks.artist: Ferdinand Gaillard, after Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres
artworks.medium: engraving on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of David A. Krol in Memory of his Brother Anthony J. Krol, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude person standing on rocky terrain. The person is leaning forward with one knee bent and an arm resting on the knee. They have short, curly hair and are looking to the left. A winged figure is crouched nearby, also with curly hair, gazing at the person. The standing person has a cloth draped over their back and is holding cylindrical objects. In the background, another figure is partially obscured by shadows, with raised arms. The setting includes a dark rocky cave with a city or settlement visible in the distance through an opening in the rocks.

artworks.title: Porta San Lorenzo, Rome
artworks.artist: Victor-François-Eloi Biennourry
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on blue wove paper, mounted on an album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient city wall with crenellations and a tower positioned on the left side. The horizon line is low, with no competing elements. The brushstrokes are subtle, suggesting a watercolor technique. The color palette consists of muted earthy tones and pale blue. A path or road leads the eye towards distant architectural structures, creating depth. The city wall extends towards additional towers in the distance under a pale blue sky.

artworks.title: The Deposition
artworks.artist: Thomas Blanchet
artworks.medium: red chalk with pen and brown ink and gray wash on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in various positions. A figure is centrally positioned, partially wrapped in cloth, being lowered from a cross. Other figures are assisting in this process. Surrounding them are several individuals, some on ladders reaching up to the cross, and others supporting from below. The figures wear different types of clothing, ranging from long, flowing garments to draped or historical attire. The individuals have indistinct facial features and varying hairstyles. The overall composition is dynamic, filled with movement and surrounded by abstract elements hinting at architecture or nature.

artworks.title: Cavalry Battle by a River
artworks.artist: Louis-Nicolas van Blarenberghe
artworks.medium: gouache on vellum, laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: The image depicts a battle scene from an elevated point of view. It shows action close to us and the landscape in the distance. The horizon is in the upper third of the painting, showing land meeting the sky with distant blue hills or mountains. The sky has billowing clouds, and the brushstrokes focus on the movement of smoke and interactions of figures and horses. The color palette includes earthy tones of browns and greens, contrasting with deep blues and whites. In the foreground, two figures on horseback are prominently featured among soldiers and battle smoke. More figures are seen farther away. The ground is rugged with a body of water to the left.
